title: B1 interpretive clarifications + two-level raw-proposal provenance
status: sealed before B1-small replication (seeds 4010+); frozen so it cannot look like an explanation authored after the replication data
scope: INTERPRETATION + PROVENANCE ONLY — no change to the hypothesis space, the success criterion, tau_ID, the law grammar, or the NUMERIC reference posterior. The frozen PILOT_B1_SPEC.md (spec_hash b720abb855b59b04) is NOT edited; its stale sections were already superseded by A-005 and this records further interpretation on top.

clarifications.C1_posterior_is_normative_reference_not_: P*(h|E) is the NORMATIVE PREREGISTERED reference under the declared uniform-bijection prior P(h,sigma) proportional to 1. It is not 'the only rational belief' and not physical ground truth. A deviation (e.g. the Pilot-A 2006-type non-uniform weighting) is a DEVIATION FROM THE PREREGISTERED REFERENCE, not 'absolutely wrong belief'. An agent that declares a different prior before the session is judged as a different policy, not as an error. The frozen reference exists so measurements are comparable, not to deny alternative priors.
clarifications.C2_permanent_tractability_limit: The exact reference posterior counts consistent bijections = the permanent of a 0/1 matrix, which is #P-hard in general. Exact computation is tractable ONLY at the current small-world scale (n_train ~6). Scaling B1 requires approximation of the permanent or a differently-structured latent-assignment family. Recorded as a known limit; NOT solved now.
clarifications.C3_ig_law_of_probe_operational_not_liter: A-005's invariant 'IG_law(PROBE)=0' is OPERATIONALLY correct — probing ALONE never discriminates laws (verified by the probe-free adversarial bot that cannot reach the blind criterion). It is NOT literally true post-experiment: a PROBE on a symbol whose EXPERIMENT was already observed can have IG_law > 0, because it completes the H<->Sigma coupling. Empirically found in the B1-small audit (seed 4006, action P:Kr: IG_H=1.0 with negative interaction = redundancy). The PRESERVED invariant is the operational one; the literal marginal statement is hereby corrected.
